# Rescana

> > Rescana provides in-depth cybersecurity intelligence and technical analysis of APT campaigns, zero-day vulnerabilities, and emerging cyber threats.

Rescana delivers comprehensive threat intelligence reports covering advanced persistent threats (APTs) like Mustang Panda, critical vulnerability analyses including zero-day exploits, and detailed incident investigations across enterprise platforms. The site focuses on actionable technical insights for security professionals tracking nation-state actors, supply chain attacks, and sophisticated cyber-espionage campaigns.

## Key Topics

- MITRE ATT&CK framework
- APT campaigns and cyber-espionage
- Mustang Panda threat actor
- Zero-day vulnerabilities
- Remote Code Execution (RCE)
- Supply chain attacks
- Social engineering and phishing
- Microsoft 365 and SaaS security
- Credential harvesting techniques
- Data breach analysis
- Vulnerability exploitation (T1190)
- Nation-state threat actors (China, Asia)
- Infostealer malware (Lumma Stealer)
- Critical infrastructure targeting
- PowerShell-based attacks
